match one's expectations: The new phone was expensive, but I hope its camera and battery life will match my expectations.
這支新手機很貴，但我希望它的相機和電池續航力能符合我的預期。
match the description: The police stopped a man in a red jacket because he seemed to match the description given by the witness.
警方攔下一名穿紅外套的男子，因為他似乎符合目擊者所提供的描述。
match colors: My sister spends an hour every morning trying to match colors so her shirt and shoes look good together.
我姊姊每天早上花一小時配色，好讓她的上衣和鞋子搭起來好看。
match funds: The company promised to match funds raised by employees, so every dollar they donated became two.
公司承諾對等出資，配合員工募得的款項，所以他們捐的每一元都變成兩元。
match someone's offer: When another company offered Lisa a higher salary, her boss agreed to match their offer to keep her.
另一家公司開給麗莎更高薪水時，她的老闆同意開出同樣的條件來留住她。
meet one's match: The chess champion had won every game this year, but he finally met his match in a twelve-year-old girl.
這位西洋棋冠軍今年每場都贏，但他終於在一名十二歲女孩身上遇到了棋逢敵手的對手。
mature into a leader: The shy boy who joined our team three years ago has begun to mature into a leader everyone respects.
三年前加入我們隊上的那個害羞男孩，已經開始成長為人人尊敬的領袖。
the bond matures: My grandfather bought a government bond years ago, and he will get all his money back when the bond matures.
我祖父多年前買了一張政府債券，等債券到期時，他就能拿回全部的錢。
wine matures: The farmer keeps the bottles in a cool, dark cellar for years while the wine matures slowly.
那位農夫把酒瓶放在陰涼黑暗的地窖裡好幾年，讓酒慢慢熟成。
mature quickly: Children who have to take care of their younger brothers and sisters often mature quickly.
必須照顧弟弟妹妹的孩子往往成熟得很快。
measure success: Some people measure success by how much money they make, but my father measures it by how happy his family is.
有些人以賺多少錢來衡量成功，但我父親是用家人有多快樂來衡量。
measure up to: Jason worked hard all year because he was afraid his grades would not measure up to his brother's.
傑森整年都很用功，因為他擔心自己的成績達不到哥哥的標準。
measure one's words: When you talk to reporters about the accident, you should measure your words carefully to avoid trouble.
當你和記者談論這起意外時，應該謹慎斟酌用詞，以免惹上麻煩。
measure the impact: Scientists are trying to measure the impact of plastic waste on fish living near the coast.
科學家正試著評估塑膠垃圾對沿岸魚類的影響。
take measures: After several students got sick, the school decided to take measures to keep the cafeteria cleaner.
在幾名學生生病後，學校決定採取措施讓餐廳保持更乾淨。
for good measure: Mom packed two sandwiches and an apple for my trip, and she added a chocolate bar for good measure.
媽媽幫我的旅行準備了兩個三明治和一顆蘋果，還額外加上一條巧克力。
meet the deadline: We stayed up until midnight to finish the report because we had to meet the deadline on Friday.
我們熬到半夜完成報告，因為必須趕上星期五的期限。
meet demand: The bakery hired three more workers because it could not make enough bread to meet demand during the holidays.
這家麵包店多雇了三名員工，因為假期間做的麵包不夠滿足需求。
meet the requirements: To join the swimming team, you must meet the requirements of swimming 400 meters in under eight minutes.
要加入游泳隊，你必須符合要求，在八分鐘內游完四百公尺。
meet with approval: The plan to build a new park downtown is sure to meet with approval from almost everyone in the city.
在市中心興建新公園的計畫肯定會獲得幾乎全市居民的認可。
meet the standard: The factory had to close for a month because its products did not meet the standard for safety.
那家工廠必須停工一個月，因為它的產品沒有達到安全標準。
meet the cost: His parents sold their car so that they could meet the cost of his university education abroad.
他的父母賣掉車子，才能支付他出國念大學的費用。
meet halfway: I wanted an action movie and my wife wanted a comedy, so we agreed to meet halfway and watch an adventure film.
我想看動作片，太太想看喜劇，所以我們同意各讓一步，看一部冒險片。
melt one's heart: The little puppy looked up at me with its big sad eyes, and it completely melted my heart.
那隻小狗用牠又大又憂傷的眼睛抬頭看我，完全融化了我的心。
melt into the crowd: The thief ran out of the store, hoping to melt into the crowd at the busy night market.
小偷衝出商店，希望能消失在熱鬧夜市的人群中。
melt away: As soon as she heard her best friend's kind words, all her anger seemed to melt away.
她一聽到好友體貼的話，所有怒氣似乎都消散了。
the snow melts: Every spring, when the snow melts on the mountains, the river near our village becomes wide and fast.
每年春天山上的雪融化時，我們村子附近的河就會變得又寬又急。
melt down: The little boy began to melt down and cry loudly when his mother refused to buy him the toy.
媽媽不肯買玩具給他時，小男孩開始崩潰並大聲哭鬧。
